independentInventory.basis: One direct opening of the complete original PNG, recorded before reading the repaired FigureSpec or author inventory.

inventory.visible: Two upright stands, each on a broad multi-foot base. A horizontal rail crosses and extends beyond both uprights above the spring line. The stand-to-rail attachments are visible.
Two horizontal coiled springs lie on opposite sides of one central ball. The left spring is fixed to the left upright below the rail. The right spring continues toward the right pulley.
A small circular wheel or roller sits on the rail directly above the ball. A short vertical hanger/link joins this carrier to the central ball.
A circular pulley is mounted on the right upright below the rail, near spring height. The rope from the right spring approaches it horizontally and leaves diagonally downward to the right.

At the lower right, a separate circular disk has a central pivot and a distinct offset attachment near its left/lower-left rim. The diagonal rope terminates at that offset attachment, not at the central pivot. A small ribbed motor/base lies beneath the disk.
A curved arrow inside the disk's right side has an arrowhead at its upper end. Its sense is upward on the right side, hence counterclockwise in the image plane.
A long outlined horizontal ruler lies below the ball and springs. It has repeated unnumbered ticks descending from its upper edge. No readable measurement values or units are supplied.

No readable letter labels, numerical dimensions, scale values, angular speed, force arrows, axes, coordinate grid, table, separate subparts, or answer annotations occur in the apparatus. Fine coil/tick detail is schematic, not a recoverable quantitative datum.
